_comment: Maps the canonical agent model TIERS (from each agent's harness-hints.claude-code.model, or an explicit harness-hints.pi.model) to a concrete pi --model pattern. These are Anthropic IDs from pi's model registry (@earendil-works/pi-ai models.generated.js). Empty string => omit `model:` so the subagent inherits pi's default model. Override per-run with env PI_MODEL_OPUS / PI_MODEL_SONNET / PI_MODEL_HAIKU. Requires an Anthropic provider configured in pi (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or providers config). Bump the version suffix as newer GA models land (e.g. opus-4.6/4.7/4.8).
